::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/organization/model_prices/{id}"}
#docs
One dated list row: the id a usage line cites in `rating.segments[]`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The row's id (mpr_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_price`. One of `model_price`. |
| `id` | `string` | The model price's id. |
| `provider` | `string` | The payment provider. |
| `model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `token_type` | `string` | `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`, … as the source names them. |
| `currency` | `string` | The model price's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | Minor units (cents for USD) per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.25"`. |
| `quantity_divisor` | `integer` | 1,000,000 for tokens; 1,000 for counted items such as web searches. |
| `effective_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The instant we apply this price from. Null = the model's first price. |
| `source_effective_from` | `string` | The source's own date for this price. |
| `source` | `string` | Where the model price comes from. |
| `source_version` | `string` | The model price's source version. |
| `rounded` | `boolean` | The source value had more than 12 decimal places in cents: rounded half-up once. |
| `last_seen_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the source last listed this model. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The list row. |
| `404` | No such model price. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/organization/model_prices/mpr_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
